mono-4141.d: Proof of Design for a Printed Textile, an ornament print (1800–1820) from the Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum, its marks printed as one ink. For people who linger in print rooms.

mono-4155.d: Highbush Blackberry (Rubus argutus), a botanical study by Mary Vaux Walcott (1919) from the Smithsonian American Art Museum, printed as a one-ink halftone. Old work, printed new.
